result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on expanding the product (1-ρe^{θi})^n(1-ρe^{-θi})^n into a cosine series and on evaluating integrals of the form ∫ cos nθ dθ/(r cos θ + xi + α + βi) by substituting y = e^{θi} and using the roots α, 1/α of y² + 2py + 1.

methods.what: Binomial expansion of (1-ρe^{θi})^n(1-ρe^{-θi})^n as a double sum and regrouping into a cosine series in θ
Substitution y=e^{θi} turning the integral of cos nθ/(r cos θ + ...) into a contour integral of a rational function
Factoring the denominator y²+2py+1 into roots α and 1/α with α+1/α = -2p
Residue value of the integral in terms of the root α
Derivative of the root α with respect to parameter p
